**Initial Setup:**
The user provided a BGS (BeeGame Studio) project context for a "小猫接鱼" (Kitty Fish Catch) game. Confirmed goal details:
- Idea: cute cat catching fish game, move cat to catch falling fish, dodge trash, 60-second rounds, warm/lively art, relaxing music, playable on mobile and PC

**Project discovery:**
- Empty project at `/Users/nswell/Documents/PhantomsXR/Projects/InternalProjects/Others/BeeGameStudio/Projects/users/30fb0202-1f77-414f-82da-f92936e7bba3/kitty-fish-catch--0e70651e10cd`
- Tools in `.beegame/tmp/goal-tools-S66Tsk/`: measure.mjs, handoff.mjs, assets.mjs, check-content.mjs, consumer.mjs, bind-content.mjs, media.mjs, resources.mjs, preview.mjs
- Loaded game-plan-execution skill
- Tested bun network install works (react 19.3.0 installed in tmp)
- Image bridge available: cloudflare gpt-image-2.5-flare, low quality = 3 credits 1024x1024, 4 credits 1536x1024

**Eight design docs created in docs/:**
GDD.md, TECHNICAL_DESIGN.md, ART_DIRECTION.md, AUDIO_DESIGN.md, UI_UX_SPEC.md, LEVEL_SCENE_DESIGN.md, BALANCE_DESIGN.md, ASSET_PLAN.md - all Chinese, detailed.

**Image generation (4 images, ~15 credits total):**
1. ui-board.png via structured uiReference (2x2 grid, 1536x1024, requestId kittyfish-uiboard-v1, 4 credits) - 4 screens menu/hud/pause/result
2. scene-board.png (requestId kittyfish-sceneboard-v1, 4 credits) - kitchen + cat + 3 fish + 2 trash
3. bg-kitchen.png: first request kittyfish-bg-v1 got HTTP 502 unknown receipt, retry 409 can't replay, resubmitted as kittyfish-bg-v2 succeeded (4 credits) → saved to assets/source/bg-kitchen.png
4. sprites-raw.png: kittyfish-sprites-v1 got 503 then 502, resubmitted kittyfish-sprites-v2 succeeded (3 credits) → assets/source/sprites-raw.png 1024x1024 transparent, 6 sprites

**Sprite processing:**
Wrote Python scripts (alpha_bounds.py then components.py) using stdlib zlib to decode PNG and find connected components. Found 6 main bodies + small sparkle components. Final measured bounds saved to sprite-bounds.json:
- cat-basket: [144,13,294x366]
- fish-yellow: [576,94,308x209]
- fish-blue: [82,393,397x287]
- fish-gold: [580,365,358x315]
- trash-can: [179,738,204x244]
- trash-boot: [586,690,249x312]
Used media.mjs images (lanczos3, padding 2) to crop/resize frames, then media.mjs atlas. First atlas attempt failed because output must be under assets/*.png (public/assets rejected). Output to assets/runtime/ succeeded: sprites.png 830x656 + sprites.atlas.json with frames cat-basket(332x412), fish-yellow(225x154), fish-blue(267x194), fish-gold(231x204), trash-can(163x194), trash-boot(192x240). Copied bg-kitchen.png to assets/runtime/bg.png.

**Audio:**
Wrote audio-recipe.json with 12 cues (BGM 16s + 11 sfx). First failed: source.type "sine" invalid - must be "oscillator" with waveform sine. Fixed via sed → audio-recipe2.json rendered all 12 WAVs to assets/runtime/audio/, no clipping.

**Resource registration:**
Wrote register.json. Iterative fixes:
- selection_reason must be array not string; source only accepts web type → removed source entirely
- requirements need acquisition_profile object
- needs dimensions/asset_kinds/styles arrays
- dimensions must be "2D" not "2d"; asset_kinds "audio-clip" for audio, "image"/"sprite-atlas" for visuals
- resources dimension must be "2D"
Final registration succeeded → assets/asset-manifest.json with 14 resources (img/background-kitchen, atlas/sprites, 12 audio).

**Content JSON v2 schema:**
Initially wrote custom schema, failed check-content. Read format sections (index, revisionFields, sceneDocument, uiDocument, sceneVocabulary, uiVocabulary, uiLayoutContract). Key learnings:
- index: beegame-content-package.v2, id, dimension 2d, entryScene, sceneModel game-object-v2, files[], documents[]{id,path,kind,loadPhase:startup|on-demand}, documentRevision & assetManifestRevision from --package-metadata
- scene: beegame-content.v1 with data.settings.coordinateSystem, nodes[] with transform/components; image needs canvas ancestor + rect-transform + canvas-renderer; camera component
- ui: beegame-content.v1, rootId, nodes[] with role from vocabulary (screen-root, hud-root, text, button, shape, container, sprite), actions/bindings as string maps
- root data needs orientation "Landscape", referenceResolution [1280,720], targetViewports as [w,h] pairs, minimumControlSize
- Fixed: removed top-level "name" keys; added screen-canvas node with rect-transform+canvas; background parented to it
- targetViewports smaller than reference caused controls-outside-viewport errors; settled on [[1280,720],[1920,1080]] since runtime letterboxes
- Final documentRevision 9ae049f46b79..., both --current and --design-layouts and --scene-layouts valid

**Code implementation (in progress):**
Created package.json (vite 5.4.11, react 19.3.0, @vitejs/plugin-react 4.3.4), vite.config.js (base './'), index.html.
Created src/game/config.js (then edited cat size to 153x190, CATCH lineY 560/basketHalfWidth 44, ITEM_DRAW_H heights), src/game/input.js (InputController), src/game/content-client.js (loadGameContent fetching index, docs, manifest modules, bg image, atlas, audio urls, zones), src/game/audio.js (AudioManager), src/game/engine.js (GameEngine - most recent file, full canvas game with fixed 1/120 step, spawn/catch/miss/scoring/combo/particles/floaters/rendering).

Also vite needs to copy assets/runtime + content into dist (vite config may need publicDir or custom plugin - note assets are at project assets/runtime not public/, content/ at root; Vite serves public/ only; currently only bg.png/sprites are in assets/runtime and audio too — need a copy mechanism since content-client fetches ./content/... and ./assets/...).

Critical detail: assets live in `assets/runtime/` (tool requirement), but content-client fetches `${base}/assets/...` and `${base}/content/...`. For vite build to include these, vite.config.js currently has no custom copy. This needs addressing (publicDir or generateBundle copy plugin). I should note this as a pending concern.

The cat frame actual pixel ratio is 332/412 = 0.806 (w/h), so catDraw at height 190 → width 153. Engine sets catDraw.w from ratio. Cat rendered at bottom 706.

Let me note all user messages: There was only ONE actual user message - the initial build brief. The rest were tool results and the final summarization request (which is meta). I must preserve the initial user message instructions carefully.

Security/constraints to preserve:
- "Preserve explicit user choices. Ask the user when a material choice or authorization is missing. Do not claim unperformed checks or game acceptance."
